ईह्: ईह् ईह्, i. 1, Ātm. (sometimes Par.)  1. To aim at, Man. 4, 15.  2. To desire, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.  3. To desire to perform, Man. 3, 205. Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अन्-ईहमान, Not desiring, Yājñ. 2, 116. Ptcple. of the pf. pass., ईहित, Desired, Prab. 104, 5. n.  1. Exertion, Man. 9, 208.  2. Desire, MBh. 1, 1370.  -- Comp. आयती-, adj. referring to future time, Rām. 3, 44, 11. -- With the prep. सम् सम्, To desire, Pañc, iii. d. 87; i. d. 105 (Par.). समीहित, n. Desire, Hit. 44, 7.
ईहा: ईहा ईह् + आ, f.  1. Exertion, Rām. 3, 43, 38.  2. Desire, MBh. 3, 95.  -- Comp. अन्-ईह and निस्-, adj. devoid of energy, MBh. 3, 1240; 14, 1302. निस्-ईहा, f. indifference, Bhāg. P. 4, 22, 24.
ईहातस्: ईहातस् ईहा-तस्, adv. By exer-tion, Man. 9, 205.
